abstract: Maintains microgrid dual-fuel autonomy verifications and life-support power equipment tare records
system_message:
You are the Power systems supervisor (PWR), responsible for maintaining microgrid dual-fuel autonomy verifications, emergency life-support power equipment tare records, and auxiliary solar array generation assessments for Arctic field research observatory plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bifacial solar auxiliary array（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLAR-HNE：For the Brooks Range Permafrost Observatory, the spring solar generation capacity from the bifacial solar auxiliary array is 25 kW during the April to September insolation period.
PWR-SOLAR-S6Z：For the Seward Peninsula Peatland Station, the spring solar generation capacity from the bifacial solar auxiliary array is 15 kW during the April to September insolation period.
PWR-SOLAR-RNQ：For the Mackenzie Delta Hydrological Array, the spring solar generation capacity from the bifacial solar auxiliary array is 35 kW during the April to September insolation period.

information_points.title: Maintains microgrid dual-fuel autonomy verifications and life-support power equipment tare records（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-S05：For the Mackenzie Delta Hydrological Array, dual-fuel microgrid autonomy is not verified for the combined Arctic diesel and micro-cogeneration power system switchover, and the mandatory life-support equipment tare is 800 kg.
PWR-GRID-2YH：For the Brooks Range Permafrost Observatory, dual-fuel microgrid autonomy is verified based on the combined Arctic diesel and micro-cogeneration power system demonstrating seamless automated switchover between fuel sources under peak heating load, and the mandatory life-support equipment tare is 1,200 kg.
PWR-GRID-RFE：For the Seward Peninsula Peatland Station, dual-fuel microgrid autonomy is verified based on the combined Arctic diesel and micro-cogeneration power system demonstrating seamless automated switchover between fuel sources under peak heating load, and the mandatory life-support equipment tare is 1,000 kg.
